title: Salsa Burgers — Launched in 12 Days
excerpt: How we went from brand brief to first delivery order in under two weeks using Bangkok operations and platform partnerships.
contentHtml:
The Challenge

A new F&B brand needed to launch in Bangkok quickly to validate product-market fit. Time was critical—every week delayed meant lost market testing opportunities.

Our Approach

Using our existing cloud kitchen infrastructure, local delivery platform connections, and operations team, we accelerated the launch timeline from the typical 4–8 weeks down to just 12 days.

The Result

Salsa Burgers went live across three delivery platforms (GrabFood, Foodpanda, Lineman) with their first customer order just 12 days after the brand brief was signed. Real revenue from day one, validated product positioning, and a foundation for scaling across Bangkok.

Key Takeaways

  • Existing infrastructure matters—we didn't waste time setting up kitchens or negotiating platform partnerships.
  • Local expertise accelerates decisions—every operational decision was made based on 2+ years in this market.
  • Focus on execution—no lengthy roadmaps, just results.
author: NC Global Assets
